title: Tolkster config.json
description: The owner's settings, ~/.tolkster/config.json. A key outside this schema exits 2.

$schema.description: This schema's path, written by init and host join.

name.description: The owner's first name, as the agent's lines call them.

coAuthor.description: The Co-authored-by trailer on commits: Name <email>.

worker.description: The Worker's address: https, or http only for localhost.

reviewers.description: GitHub logins whose PR feedback counts.

maxRounds.description: Review rounds before Copilot's reviews go to the owner.

deepAt.description: The size at which a pre-push review goes deep.

upTo.description: The largest size the rung takes; rising from rung to rung, left out only on the last.

default.description: The rung, counted from 1, an issue with no size takes.

repos.description: Keyed by an Orca repo's display name.

id.description: The recipe's id in the repo's orca.yaml.

machines.description: Machines that may exist at once.

slotsEach.description: Workers at once on each machine.

destroyAfter.description: Minutes a machine stays asleep, or idle when its recipe can't sleep, before it is destroyed.

land.description: How a worker's change reaches the default branch: a PR (the default), or tolkster land's push straight onto it.

trace.description: Workers' sessions show what they write between calls and each call, redacted (docs/voice.md). Off unless set.

releasePipeline.description: The ID of the Linear release pipeline a development build's rebuild syncs a release to (docs/realtime.md). tolkster setup sets it.

timing.description: Whether workers' sessions are timed and the listen host keeps it (docs/timing.md). On unless false.

slots.description: Workers at once by host name, "local" for this machine (6 unless set). A paired host with no entry, or 0, takes no work; a recipe machine takes its repo's slotsEach.
